option_relations.rationale: Semi-invasive aspergillosis is a form of chronic pulmonary aspergillosis, characterized by local invasion without widespread dissemination.
Subacute Invasive Aspergillosis (SAIA) is a recognized form of chronic pulmonary aspergillosis, and pneumothorax can be a complication.

Post-COVID-19 Invasive Pulmonary Aspergillosis, if it progresses over months as described, would fall under the umbrella of chronic pulmonary aspergillosis, especially given the imaging findings of aspergilloma and cavitation.
Necrotizing Aspergillus Pneumonia, when it has a subacute or chronic course with cavitation and aspergilloma formation, can be considered a form of chronic pulmonary aspergillosis.
